text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As her debut race drew closer,
Kiseki's motivation kept soaring.
Even during training that day—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Shukuchi!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...SHSHSHSHSHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“Chanting her ‘special move’ as she ran,
she quickly switched her footing against the ground.”
choice_data_list: Focus more on "stepping with rhythm" rather than "kicking off."
Focus more on "stepping with rhythm" rather than "kicking off," okay?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Yes!
It's a way of moving by using your body's core!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Since the foot's ground contact time is shortened,
your leg turnover will increase too. It's useful, right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her ideas may look like techniques straight out of a manga,
but they contain solid "seeds of thought."
choice_data_list: (I want to channel that rationally into running.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While bringing out the fun and uniqueness she has,
how can I polish it into the ultimate, logically sound,
most thrilling running style?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: This is where I prove my worth as a Trainer.
choice_data_list: By the way, which part of your sole are you landing on right now?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Wait, the landing is...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Toes first! But for this running form,
would pushing off with the whole sole be more stable!?
choice_data_list: Shall we test which technique is more effective?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
~~gh, right!
I think I'd also like to try out a version where I land on my heels!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I was thinking that could transform into an energy-saving mid-race skill............ Ah, and also!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Besides that, I've also prepared things like
'Double Breath' and 'Courier Sprint'!
I'd love for you to take a look at all of them!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And so, Kiseki
brought forth one new idea
after another."
choice_data_list: (Her talent is the real deal.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I want to create exciting races."
That's how she puts her creative ideas to work in her races.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I thought my job was figuring out how to handle that natural-born gift, but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The day of the debut race.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Phew... haaah... ngh!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Kiseki has been restless for a while now.
She's pacing around the room with movements that seem to emphasize her neck in particular...
choice_data_list: Uh... You okay, Kiseki?
Um... Are you okay, Kiseki?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm fine!
I'm, like... suuuper fired up!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right!
Maybe I should review the race strategy once more!
After all, today is—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ah...
choice_data_list: ...Kiseki!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I quickly picked up the tablet that had
slipped from her hands... and handed it back to her.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, oops. Trainer.
I-I'm sorry...!"
choice_data_list: Don't worry about it. More importantly, are you okay?
Don't worry about it. More importantly, are you alright?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, yes. I'm fine!
I'm really okay, so...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I'm okay...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "She repeats 'I'm fine' over and over, as if to convince herself. Watching her like that..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Unlike the seemingly invincible girl she had always appeared to be,
she looked... like an ordinary Umamusume desperately struggling.
choice_data_list: (...This is a miracle, too.)
(...This is a miracle, too, isn't it?)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To keep Kiseki from getting any more nervous,
I speak to her while carefully avoiding words like 'anxious.'
choice_data_list: Neither of us can stop trembling with excitement, huh?
Neither of us can stop trembling with excitement, huh?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Shivering... in anticipation...?
choice_data_list: Ah, you're always so motivated
Yeah, you're always so motivated.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Y-Yes!! Exactly! I'm just trembling with anticipation, that's all!
choice_data_list: Then go pour all that passion into your race!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Yes!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Kiseki is a truly talented Umamusume.
The well of ideas she sparks is bottomless.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: However, the Twinkle Series is not forgiving enough for one to compete on talent alone.
choice_data_list: (As her Trainer, I need to support her too.)
(As her Trainer, I need to support her, too.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I'm not just a reader who enjoys
Kiseki's creations. I'm her supporter,
creating these works together with her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There's still so much—so very much—
that I can do for her in the days ahead.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Shaking with excitement.
I see... so that's what 'trembling for battle' means.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, that really makes you feel like the protagonist.
Super... protagonist-like!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ngh! Keep your eyes on me, everyone!
Today is my "Episode 1"!
